scenes.headline: Bees see ultraviolet, so many flowers show them hidden nectar guides.
If it's generated, the screen says so.

caption:
AI scenery, real bees, clearly labelled.

Many flowers carry ultraviolet patterns invisible to us that guide bees toward nectar, while red flowers often look dark to them.

Source: USDA Forest Service, Britannica. Flower animation: AI-generated (labelled).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Medium risk: AI label on screen and in caption, generation limited to a stylised non-animal scene; every animal shot is a real photo. Never presented as real footage.
